title: Reunion with Li Muwan
summary: Two months on, Wang Lin's clone has blown up five pill furnaces while learning alchemy, and on his way to the South Garden he meets Cheng Xian, a cheerful outer disciple who begs for an introduction to Cheng Ling. He learns that Zhou Lin's master, Elder Li of the South Garden, is one of the Cloud Sky Sect's three rank 5 alchemists and was once of the Luohe Sect, and she is Li Muwan, now at early Core Formation. After 200 years and without Ma Liang's face she does not recognise him, though his voice stirs her and she gives him a sturdier furnace; Sun Zhenwei presses her to accept a marriage the founding ancestor has arranged. Cheng Ling humiliates Cheng Xian and nearly kills him, and Wang Lin's clone reaches Foundation Establishment, then late Foundation, with a Foundation pill recipe from Cheng Xian. When Cheng Xian's spirit ape staggers back dead, its core ripped out, Wang Lin decides to save him and calls his main body to merge.
